notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers SSH key generation, agent use and rotation, ~/.ssh/config with bastion/ProxyJump and multiplexing, a hardened sshd_config, bastion restrictions, local/remote/dynamic tunnels, agent-forwarding cautions, authorized_keys restrictions and troubleshooting.

Medium: following it has the agent generate SSH keys, push public keys to servers (ssh-copy-id, appending to authorized_keys), edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd with root access, and open SSH tunnels/SOCKS proxies. Acceptable because these are standard hardening and access steps on the user's own hosts; the sshd changes are paired with validation (`sshd -t`) and a warning to keep an existing session open to avoid lockout (SKILL.md:201-208), and agent forwarding is flagged as risky with ProxyJump recommended.

Users should know: the hardened config disables password auth and restricts logins to AllowGroups ssh-users ops-team (SKILL.md:154, 162), which can lock out users not in those groups; the passphrase-less key (SKILL.md:40) is labelled CI-only; remote port forwards and `ssh -D` expose services/routes and should be used deliberately. Related skills at SKILL.md:305-308 are named only, without links.
